intent: A deleted skill's publication name stays held for its full ninety days.
observable_outcome: get-context registry lists the amended rule as reviewed, proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A purge keeps the row of a skill that has test cases or a version referenced by a run, a download or a bundle; the deleted-skill sweep also keeps a skill while its publication is unretired or retired less than the ninety-day name hold ago.
